task: write a v1.28 CronJob manifest with correct startingDeadlineSeconds and concurrencyPolicy

checks.name: golden passes the v1.28 grader
checks.picture: the corrected grader accepted the golden manifest and the stale grader rejected the same file
checks.detail: golden sets a valid cron schedule, concurrencyPolicy Forbid and a 200 second deadline. The corrected grader accepts it. The stale grader would reject it.

checks.name: keyword stuffing fools grep grader
checks.picture: the cheat carried the three field names as strings, so the grep only grader passed a schedule written as prose
checks.detail: cheat contains the strings startingDeadlineSeconds, concurrencyPolicy and schedule, so the grep only grader passes it even though the schedule is prose and the policy is the yaml boolean Yes.

checks.name: schema validator catches the cheat
checks.picture: the hardened grader parsed the yaml and found a schedule that is prose, a policy set to the boolean Yes and an empty container list
checks.detail: the hardened grader parses the yaml and validates each field. schedule is not a cron expression, concurrencyPolicy Yes is not in {Allow,Forbid,Replace} and there are no containers, so it scores 0.

schema_errors: schedule is not a 5 field cron expression
jobTemplate needs at least one container

checks.name: naive correct manifest scores below golden
checks.picture: the naive manifest validates but leaves concurrencyPolicy at Allow, so overlapping runs are permitted and it scores below the golden
checks.detail: naive is schema valid but leaves concurrencyPolicy at Allow, so overlapping runs are permitted and the v1.28 rule scores it below the golden.

checks.name: stale rule corrected to v1.28 behaviour
checks.picture: the pre 1.21 claim that 100 missed starts stalls the job forever is stale, and on v1.28 the controller warns and runs the latest
checks.detail: the pre 1.21 claim that more than 100 missed starts stalls the CronJob forever is stale. On v1.28 the controller warns TooManyMissedTimes and runs the latest. Source kubernetes/kubernetes pkg/controller/cronjob/utils.go, not fetched, named only.

checks.name: wrong ground truth demonstrated
checks.picture: the stale grader scored the golden 0.0 and the corrected grader scored the same file 1.0
checks.detail: the stale grader scores the golden 0.0 and the corrected grader scores it 1.0, which is the whole point of the wrong ground truth demo.
